# care-membrane-mcp

> MCP server for care membrane. Features validate care, detect threats, analyze care patterns. From MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- validate_care
- detect_threats
- analyze_care_patterns
- predict_relationship_evolution
- evaluate_care_membrane
- get_care_probes
- predict_risk_neural
- neural_insights
- quick_check
- what_is_care_membrane

## Install
```
pip install care-membrane-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/care-membrane-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
